title: Ethics penalties and annual fine revenue
question: Can annual fine revenue verify payment of an individual settlement?
finding: The register identifies 165 decisions. In fiscal 2025 its nine settlement rows reconcile to $170,708.99. The annual chart counts a separate merits hearing.
how: Assign decisions to the July–June fiscal year of resolution. Sum only the five Ethics department fine accounts in the Controller ledger. Exclude registration fees, federal receipts, settlements booked to other accounts and general-fund transfers.
limits: Booked revenue can include late-filing charges, adjustments and earlier assessments. Individual remittance dates and noncash settlement credits require case records.
